train: Independent generator stream; curriculum registration pending baseline diagnosis. No final realization is training input.
confirmation_semantics: Three new continuation trajectories from common frozen u640 after recipe freeze; preserve optimizer checkpoint, explicitly branch RNG after restoration and fresh physical reset. Not from-scratch replications.

final.realization_release: Controller generates secret nonce only after final recipe/checkpoint-selection rule frozen, commits hash before final execution; runner derives common condition streams for baseline and each final model; nonce/raw revealed only after all model checkpoints frozen.
final.holdout_use: Single batch only; no subsequent tuning with this holdout. Actual scoring bug requires independent review and contamination record.

derivation_candidate.pairing: Use realization index0 for common baseline/three-model comparison. BASELINE_SUFFICIENT uses all three distinct realizations. Never derive realization index from model identity.

baseline_sufficient: Three different realized environment streams, full original+new target+stress suites for each; training zero.
random_effect_evidence: Persist generator identities/states and sampled reset/measurement/pulse values; compare actual realization digests across seeds, not labels.
